issue_request: FHIR-36194 was Published/Persuasive for the FHIR-core RESTful Search page. It requested an Implicit Resources section clarifying whether implicit resources, such as implicit code systems, can be returned by FHIR RESTful search.

A pickaxe search for the approved heading found commit 8895383c74, titled 'FHIR-36914 : Searching implicit resources', which added the current search-page table-of-contents entry and paragraph matching FHIR-36194. Jira FHIR-36914 is unrelated FHIRcast work, so the commit subject appears to have used the wrong key.
